newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank repo drains 54 bln SKR from market.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank repo drains 54 bln SKR from market.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, drained 54 billion crowns from the market in Tuesday morning's reverse repurchase operation.
The repo, which will run from November 6 to November 13, was set at a fixed rate of 4.60 percent, and replaces an operation set at the same rate which drained 59 billion crowns from the market.
The Riksbank said that 13.1 percent of the bids for the tender were allocated.
This is the second of four weekly reverse repurchase operations set at 4.60 percent.
In late October, the Riksbank departed from its strategy of adjusting the repo rate every other week in favour of fixing the repo rate four weeks in advance in line with Bundesbank practice.
Since the start of the year the repo, the central rate in a three tier system, has been cut from 8.91 percent.
The floor and ceiling of the central bank's interest rate corridor, the deposit and lending rates, are set at 4.25 percent and 5.75 percent respectively.
